I will continue to fight for legislation to stand up for truck drivers that was vetoed.

David Marcus (@BlueBoxDave)

Hegseth knows what the DOW is spending, but it’s absurd to ask him about downstream costs to consumers. That’s not his job. Nobody asked Eisenhower how D-Day would impact gas prices or the cost of Thanksgiving dinner in 1944.

But the House introduced a resolution to condemn Hasan Piker.

I want a bipartisan coalition to end the war and take on the Epstein class.

Excited about this conversation with brilliant voices and leaders about the future of the progressive movement!
